Primary question: Nvidia's gross profit margin has shown a strong upward trend, reaching 75.0% in January 2025, significantly exceeding the semiconductor industry average of 42.3%. In Q2 2025, Nvidia's net profit margin was 56.53%, placing it second within the semiconductor industry. This performance is notably higher than the 2021 semiconductor industry average profit margin of 19.8%. Nvidia's revenue growth of 55.6% also surpasses the industry average of 27.71%.

Industry context: The semiconductor industry is poised for significant growth in 2025, with global sales projected to reach approximately $697 billion, an 11% increase year-over-year. This surge is primarily driven by the escalating demand for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data center technologies. While AI and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) are expected to see substantial growth, with HBM revenue potentially increasing by up to 70%, demand from the PC and smartphone markets may remain muted. Companies are investing heavily in capital expenditures, with an estimated $185 billion allocated to expand manufacturing capacity. However, potential supply chain imbalances and competition from startups pose challenges.

details.sql:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    metric,
    SUM(value) AS value
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE metric IN ('Revenue','Gross Profit','Operating Income','Net Income')
    AND ticker IN ('NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','AVGO','TXN')
    AND calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND calendar_year >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - 5)
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year, metric
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM metrics
  GROUP BY ticker, calendar_year
),
margins AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    revenue::numeric AS revenue,
    gross_profit::numeric AS gross_profit,
    operating_income::numeric AS operating_income,
    net_income::numeric AS net_income,
    (gross_profit::numeric / NULLIF(revenue::numeric, 0)) AS gross_margin,
    (operating_income::numeric / NULLIF(revenue::numeric, 0)) AS operating_margin,
    (net_income::numeric / NULLIF(revenue::numeric, 0)) AS net_margin
  FROM pivoted
),
margins_yoy AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    gross_margin,
    operating_margin,
    net_margin,
    gross_margin - LAG(gross_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY calendar_year) AS gross_margin_yoy_pp,
    operating_margin - LAG(operating_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY calendar_year) AS operating_margin_yoy_pp,
    net_margin - LAG(net_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY calendar_year) AS net_margin_yoy_pp
  FROM margins
),
industry_avg AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    AVG(gross_margin) AS gross_margin_avg,
    AVG(operating_margin) AS operating_margin_avg,
    AVG(net_margin) AS net_margin_avg
  FROM margins
  WHERE ticker IN ('AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','AVGO','TXN')
  GROUP BY calendar_year
),
industry_avg_yoy AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    gross_margin_avg,
    operating_margin_avg,
    net_margin_avg,
    gross_margin_avg - LAG(gross_margin_avg) OVER (ORDER BY calendar_year) AS gross_margin_yoy_pp,
    operating_margin_avg - LAG(operating_margin_avg) OVER (ORDER BY calendar_year) AS operating_margin_yoy_pp,
    net_margin_avg - LAG(net_margin_avg) OVER (ORDER BY calendar_year) AS net_margin_yoy_pp
  FROM industry_avg
)
SELECT
  m.calendar_year,
  m.gross_margin_yoy_pp::numeric AS nvidia_gross_margin_yoy_pp,
  i.gross_margin_yoy_pp::numeric AS industry_gross_margin_yoy_pp,
  (m.gross_margin_yoy_pp - i.gross_margin_yoy_pp)::numeric AS gross_margin_yoy_vs_industry_pp,
  m.operating_margin_yoy_pp::numeric AS nvidia_operating_margin_yoy_pp,
  i.operating_margin_yoy_pp::numeric AS industry_operating_margin_yoy_pp,
  (m.operating_margin_yoy_pp - i.operating_margin_yoy_pp)::numeric AS operating_margin_yoy_vs_industry_pp,
  m.net_margin_yoy_pp::numeric AS nvidia_net_margin_yoy_pp,
  i.net_margin_yoy_pp::numeric AS industry_net_margin_yoy_pp,
  (m.net_margin_yoy_pp - i.net_margin_yoy_pp)::numeric AS net_margin_yoy_vs_industry_pp
FROM margins_yoy m
LEFT JOIN industry_avg_yoy i
  ON m.calendar_year = i.calendar_year
WHERE m.ticker = 'NVDA'
ORDER BY m.calendar_year DESC
LIMIT 1000;
